---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature for CS2 ESP
title: "[FEATURE]"
labels: enhancement
assignees: Jesewe

---

### Description
Provide a clear and concise description of the new feature you are proposing.

### Motivation
Explain why this feature is needed and how it will benefit the CS2 ESP project and its users. Include any context or problems it would solve.

### Proposed Solution
Describe your ideal solution or implementation for the feature. Feel free to include diagrams, examples, or mock-ups to illustrate your idea.

### Alternatives Considered
List any alternative solutions or approaches you considered. Explain why you believe your proposed solution is the best option.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or information that might help us better understand your request.
